name: 施設の設備を三択で確認する一覧
prompt: Create a compact Japanese Lighthouse facility equipment answer-list component. Primary original reference controls EXACT visible states, close glyph, six rows and collapse glyph. Japanese mock controls approved wording. White #FFFFFF canvas/surfaces, no broad mint fills, no shadows. Header centered exact 'この場所の設備を確認' Meiryo Bold20/28; restore original small X close at top-left in neutral slate #526173. Under title restore original named-place subtitle translated 'ドロレス・パーク' in Regular14/24 gray, then helper exact '施設の利用しやすさについて教えてください' Regular12/16 gray. Section label '利用しやすい設備'. Six rows in this exact order: '補聴器の誘導ループ', '音声案内の設備', '車いす対応の駐車場', '車いす対応の入口', '車いす対応の座席', '車いす対応のトイレ'. Each right side has one three-way segmented choice: checkmark with 'あり', X with 'なし', circled question mark with '不明'. Restore the original distinctive check / X / circled ? glyphs, while adding the mock's concise Japanese labels next to each glyph for clarity. All labels Regular weight, no bold control copy. EXACT state matrix from original: rows1,2 UNKNOWN selected; rows3,4 YES selected; rows5,6 UNKNOWN selected. NO row has NO selected. The mock's all-unknown state is WRONG; correct it. Thin neutral borders and separators, white unselected cells/slate glyphs+ink. Selected cell white with clear green outline and forest green glyph/text, with at most very subtle local green tint, never large green panels. Natural compact rows, left labels can wrap if needed, consistent control alignment, enough width to avoid crowding. Bottom centered upward chevron plus exact '表示を減らす' Regular green, preserve collapse meaning and original glyph. No save button or additional invented rows. Keep all controls legible and entire component within tight clean margins. Source screenshot is static example, not verified current facility facts.
reviewNotes: Original six-row state matrix restored correctly (unknown, unknown, yes, yes, unknown, unknown), close/place/collapse and all Japanese rows legible. Selected green labels and bottom collapse label visibly heavier than Regular controls. Targeted typography correction warranted; preserve all geometry, states and glyphs.
